# Modules that are INTENTIONALLY red, one Lake target per line.
#
# The breaker/builder discipline in AGENTS.md has a phase in which a frozen
# red battery exists and its implementation does not. During that phase the
# default build cannot be green, and a trust gate whose control step demands a
# green build cannot run at all.
#
# This file makes that phase explicit rather than letting the gate abort. It is
# self-checking in both directions: an undeclared failure fails the gate, and a
# declared module that is actually GREEN also fails the gate, so an entry
# cannot outlive the red phase it describes.
#
# Removing the last entry restores the original all-green control.
#
# History: the payload battery Effect4Test.Schema.PayloadContract was declared
# here during its red phase and removed when the builder turned it green; the
# gate itself caught the stale entry and refused to run until it was cleared.
#
# History: Effect4Test.Environment.ContextKeyContract, the frozen breaker
# battery for environment-slice node L0, fence F-KEY (Effect4/Context/Key.lean),
# packet test/contracts/environment-context-key.contract.md, was declared here
# during its red phase and removed when the builder turned it green.

# History: Effect4Test.Protocol.ByteParserContract (the W0 byte parser breaker) and
# Effect4Test.Concurrency.RaceRepresentativeContract (the binary race closure packet)
# were declared here from their birth; both lanes were retired on 2026-09-04 with
# their batteries deleted, so the list is empty and the all-green control holds.

# The Surface library's frozen breaker packet (wave 1b of

# plan §13.7 ruling 7 requires before wave 2d builds). The breaker froze these
# from the plan alone, without reading Effect4/Surface/, which is the whole point
# of the role; they are red until §13.7 ruling 5's repair lands, which restates
# them clause for clause against the vocabulary Facts.lean actually carries. That
# repair, the Effect4Test.lean import lines and the Effect4TestSurface target are
# the coordinator's wave 4. Each entry below was elaborated with
# `lake env lean` on 2026-09-04 and observed to fail.
